2026-05-04:
Title & Date
West Orange Board of Education Public Board Meeting -- May 4, 2026

Attendees
- Present: President Rock, Vice President Vera, Dr. Bryant, Mr. Ivker, Mr. Stevenson
- Absent: None
- Trenae Lambkin, Acting Business Administrator, submitted the minutes

Purpose & Objectives
This was a regular public board meeting to act on personnel, curriculum, and finance business, including a public hearing on the proposed 2026-2027 school district budget.

Key Discussion Points
- Administration gave the Final Budget Presentation for the 2026-2027 school year.
- The Board held a public hearing on the proposed 2026-2027 budget at West Orange High School's Library Media Center.
- The Superintendent's Harassment, Intimidation and Bullying (HIB) report was presented, including 2024-2025 HIB Self-Assessment Scores by school (district score 76 out of a possible 78).
- The Board reviewed personnel actions covering resignations, retirements, appointments, additional teaching and co-curricular assignments, substitute appointments, and leaves of absence for certificated and non-certificated staff.
- The Board reviewed multiple finance items, including out-of-district student placements, contracted special-services providers, and 2026-2027 staff contract renewals.
- Several 2026-2027 pay rates and contract renewals were noted as subject to adjustment pending ratification of the Collective Bargaining Agreement.

Decisions Made
- Approved the closed and public meeting minutes of April 20, 2026 (5-0 roll call).
- Approved certificated and non-certificated staff resignations, retirements, appointments, and leaves of absence (4-0 roll call; Vera abstained).
- Approved curriculum and instruction items: Applications for School Business requests and Field Trip Destinations for 2025-2026 (5-0 roll call).
- Approved the Proposed Budget Resolution for 2026-2027: Total Appropriations $228,773,289; Anticipated Revenues $60,032,317; Taxes to be Raised $168,740,972 (5-0 roll call, part of the Finance block vote).
- Approved a Health Care Costs budget adjustment of $797,076.
- Approved the 2026-2027 Travel and Related Expense Reimbursement policy, capping travel expenditures at $93,252.
- Approved the May 4, 2026 Bills List totaling $17,734,214.04.
- Approved March 2026 budget transfers and accepted the Board Secretary's and Treasurer's financial reports for March 2026.
- Approved a settlement agreement with the parent of Student ID #1809047.
- Approved Student Meal Pricing for 2026-2027 (unchanged from 2025-2026).
- Approved the Consolidation Agreement with Classical Academy Charter School transferring Child Nutrition Program duties to the district.
- Approved submission of the Final PEA 2026-2027 Budget Planning Workbook and Narrative.
- Awarded the Natural Gas Supply contract to NRG Business Marketing LLC/NRG Energy for July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2029 at $0.81781/therm.
- Approved an out-of-district placement for a McKinney-Vento homeless student at Newark Board of Education, tuition $26,557 (unbudgeted).
- Approved a $60,000 contract with Pre-K Fiscal Consulting, LLC for Fiscal Specialist Services under the Preschool Expansion Aid program.
- Approved submission of the Perkins Grant application and acceptance of the funding award for 2026-2027.
- Approved out-of-district special services contracts, including Northwest Essex Therapeutic School & Preschool ($13,178.36), Dr. Beth Baumeister ($2,000), Union County Educational Services Commission (up to $10,000), and Mountain Lakes Board of Education (up to $380) (5-0 roll call, Finance block vote).
- Accepted the HIB Self-Assessment Scores for 2024-2025 and the HIB Report ending May 4, 2026 (5-0 roll call).
- Approved a resolution affirming the Superintendent's decision on HIB Incident Numbers 028, 029, and 030 (5-0 roll call).
- Approved renewal of 2026-2027 contracts for certificated staff, administrators, administrative assistants, custodial/maintenance staff, security, transportation, and technology staff.
- Meeting adjourned at 1:04 a.m. (5-0 voice vote).

Action Items
- Submit the Proposed 2026-2027 Budget to the Executive County Superintendent of Schools for approval -- Secretary to the Board of Education -- Not specified

Unresolved Issues
- Several 2026-2027 staff pay rates, steps, and salaries remain subject to adjustment pending ratification of the Collective Bargaining Agreement.
- The anticipated return date for one certificated staff member's medical leave (Employee #4919) was listed as TBD.

Next Steps
The next Board meeting is scheduled for June 16, 2026 at 7:30 p.m. at the West Orange High School Auditorium.

Action Items
- Execute natural gas contract with winning EMEX Reverse Auction bidder if price thresholds are met -- School Business Administrator -- Not specified
- Transmit Gregory Avenue/Mitchell Street traffic safety resolution to Township Council, the Mayor, local law enforcement, Essex County officials, and the NJ Department of Transportation -- Board Secretary/Board of Education -- Not specified
- Conduct or update a traffic study of the Gregory Avenue/Mitchell Street intersection -- Township of West Orange and appropriate governing agencies -- Not specified

- The Gregory Avenue/Mitchell Street traffic safety resolution is non-binding and does not mandate action by the Township, Essex County, or the NJ Department of Transportation, which retain authority over traffic control devices.

Perkins Grant at $8,397.00, the 2026 Summer Enrichment Program, and 2025-2026 student teacher/intern assignments (5-0 roll call).

Pleasant E.S. ($3,870,537.00) and electrical upgrades at Kelly, St. Cloud, and Washington schools ($147,499.00); a transfer of FY2025 surplus of $350,000 to cover the Food Service Fund deficit; extended settlement authority for employee #5955 (up to 30%/$64,650.00 plus about $7,500.00 in legal fees); acceptance of a donation from RWJ Barnabas valued at approximately $6,500; and rejection of all bids for Snow Removal Services Bid #25-08 (5-0 roll call).
- Approved reports: the HIB report ending December 15, 2025; a resolution affirming the Superintendent's decisions on HIB Incident Numbers 005, 006, 007, and 008; the 2026-2027 Three-Year Preschool Program Plan and Annual Update Report; the 2026-2027 Preschool Projected Enrollment Report; the fiscal year 2027 Budget Calendar; the 2026-2027 Budget goals; and the revised 2025-2026 Academic calendar (5-0 roll call).
- Adopted the resolution "Supporting Transparency, Fairness, and Predictability in the School Funding Formula," urging support for pending bills A-5966/S-4855 and A-5310/S-3917 (5-0 roll call).
- Adjourned the meeting at 8:30 p.m. (5-0 voice vote).

Action Items
- Deliver the school funding formula resolution to Governor Phil Murphy, State Senate President Nicholas Scutari, Assembly Speaker Craig Coughlin, and the 27th Legislative District's State Senate and General Assembly representatives -- West Orange Board of Education -- Not specified

Unresolved Issues
- The district cannot reliably forecast state aid revenue because the gross income figures and formula multipliers used to calculate local fair share are not released until state aid notices come out in late February, complicating budget construction.
- Transportation costs remain significantly underfunded by categorical aid (about 22.5% coverage).
- The state's extraordinary special education aid appropriation has covered only a portion of eligible district costs in recent years.
- Legislation (A-5966/S-4855 and A-5310/S-3917) that the Board is urging lawmakers to support remains pending in the Legislature.

Next Steps
The next Board meeting is the Reorganization Meeting, scheduled for 5:30 p.m. on January 6, 2026, at West Orange High School.
